modules.module_title: Operate different component at petrochemical production plant

pcs.pc_description: operate pumps, valves, reactors, heat exchangers, turbines, compressors, separators, storage tanks, piping, etc. and follow all safety protocols and procedures
regulate pumps and compressors as per the instruction of supervisor/manager
monitor and adjust production process parameters such as pressure, temperature, flow, and levels
control the plant operations such as controlling the various processes and operations within the plant and controlling the temperature, pressure and other parameters for the various processes.
read temperature in pressure gauges, flowmeters, vacuum and time, record readings in the log
monitor and operate processing unit, cracking unit, separation unit, synthesis unit, purification unit, product packaging unit, etc. to produce petrochemical product.
clean processing units’ interior by circulating solvent and chemicals as per SOP
follow all shift-specific operational procedures and protocols
report logs, finding and fault to the supervisor/manager
Assisting in Shutdown activity like preparing blinding list, adhering to safe shutdown procedure, SOP etc.
Assisting in Startup activity like leak checking, gasket checking, loop checking etc.

modules.module_title: Analyse equipment and instruments for repairing or maintenance at a petrochemical production plant

pcs.pc_description: identify the repair and maintenance need in the plant
schedule and inform repair and maintenance activity at plant
apply solution for maintenance/repair on faulty parts such as control system/electrical system/ mechanical system, etc.
check all the inspection points as per maintenance/repair checklist
test, visually inspect or using calibration instruments and tools to ensure proper functioning of repaired instrument/component
utilize the material required during repair and maintenance activity efficiently to minimize the waste and store the unused or reusable material
clean the site and remove the maintenance /repair signages from the site
inform all concerns after repair / maintenance about site readiness
maintain/prepare maintenance/repair log as per the SOP
prepare reports and documentation related to repair / maintenance in the Plant
